page.layout: One block of verse in the upper half, one column, lines indented in stanzas; below it a centred initials line "I. I. B."; below that a woodcut ornament. Running head at top, page number at top right. Faint mirrored text in the right half is show-through and is left out.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a floral or foliate tailpiece with a central face or mask) below the initials; not text, so not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page appears in the right half and faintly lower left ("I. Lc." type marks); not transcribed. Verse lines: "Qua" in the third stanza has a swash capital Q-form and may be read as Qua or Quae; "Nouaum" in the last line has a tilde-like mark over the a, possibly Nouàum or Nouẽum; both kept as read. "prouida" and "auctum" read from a worn scan. The first stanza begins mid-poem, so its opening paragraph is marked as a continuation.
